train_PPOTrainer: train the PPOTrainer to learn audio-visual navigation policies using PPO algorithm
setup_actor_critic_agent: setup actor critic agent with PPO configuration and observation space for audio-visual navigation
save_checkpoint_PPOTrainer: save the trained PPO agent checkpoint with state dict and config to checkpoint folder
eval_checkpoint_PPOTrainer: evaluate a saved PPO checkpoint on test episodes and log metrics to tensorboard
collect_rollout_step_PPOTrainer: collect a rollout step by sampling actions from actor critic and stepping the environment
